methods.name: clone_current
methods.signature: fn clone_current(&self) -> Option<L> where L: Clone
methods.summary: Returns a clone of the layer or filter's current value if it still exists. Otherwise, if the subscriber has been dropped, returns `None`.

methods.name: modify
methods.signature: fn modify(&self, f: impl FnOnce(&mut L)) -> Result<(), Error>
methods.summary: Invokes a closure with a mutable reference to the current layer or filter, allowing it to be modified in place.

methods.name: reload
methods.signature: fn reload(&self, new_value: impl Into<L>) -> Result<(), Error>
methods.summary: Replace the current [`Layer`] or [`Filter`] with the provided `new_value`.

methods.name: with_current
methods.signature: fn with_current<T>(&self, f: impl FnOnce(&L) -> T) -> Result<T, Error>
methods.summary: Invokes a closure with a borrowed reference to the current layer or filter, returning the result (or an error if the subscriber no longer exists).
